notes.title: NO TIME TO LOOT EVENT UPDATE
notes.content:
Hello Strugglers,

Dustbound is back with its biggest content drop yet — and we can’t wait for you to dive in! This update brings a brand-new map, tons of fresh content, and an all-new combo system to shake up your runs.


What’s New
New Map: Explore an entirely fresh battlefield packed with unique challenges.

New Enemies: Face off against a host of deadly new foes.

3 New Mini-Bosses + 1 New Boss: Test your skills against powerful opponents with unique mechanics.

20+ New Cards: Expand your arsenal with new strategic options.

10 New Augments: Customize and power up your build even further.

20+ New Combos: Unlock powerful synergies by playing certain cards or deploying specific drones. These combos grant special buffs, trigger new weapons, and open the door to deeper strategies.


The New Combo System
The heart of this update is the Combo System. By mixing and matching the right cards or drones, you can unlock hidden interactions that lead to powerful bonuses, devastating weapons, or unique effects. With over 20 combos to discover, experimentation is more rewarding than ever!


Jump Back In
Whether you’re here for the new bosses, the expanded deckbuilding options, or just want to break the game wide open with insane combos, this update gives you more ways to struggle, survive, and thrive.

So… what are you waiting for? Get back out there, Strugglers. Loot won’t wait.

Nordman

notes.title: Demo is live!
notes.content:
The Dustbound Demo is LIVE!

Jump in now and test your skills in the wasteland.


[previewyoutube=cWUpLGLI5Dw;full][/previewyoutube]


🔥 What’s in the demo?

 3 different heroes with unique abilities
 9 enemy types
 4 challenging bosses
 Around 70 cards to experiment with
 Meta progression to keep you coming back
 And plenty of chaos to survive


Try it out, break stuff, and let us know what you think.
And hey—don’t forget to wishlist the game if you dig it.

See you out there,
Nordman
